end.parentNote: Asha practised close observation of birds with Atharv using pictures and questions. They described beak shape, feathers, feet, feeding, and drinking, and gave examples from seeing birds in a park. Atharv mixed up or was unsure about some descriptions, but later clearly described the pigeon’s beak as small and straight and the sparrow’s as needle-like. At home, look at one bird picture together and ask Atharv to name two visible features and what each may help the bird do.
